name: Fiddle Leaf Fig
hook: Dropping leaves? Check water, light and drafts first.

steps.title: Bright light, near a window
steps.tip: Place near a bright window with filtered light; shield it from hot afternoon sun.

steps.title: Water when top 5 cm is dry
steps.tip: Water deeply then let it drain; soggy soil can cause dark spots and leaf drop.

steps.title: No drafts, no moving
steps.tip: Keep it away from heaters, AC vents and doors, and give it a quarter turn as you care for it.

steps.title: Wipe the big leaves
steps.tip: Dust blocks light, so wipe leaves with a damp cloth now and then; it likes medium to high humidity.

steps.title: Feed in growing season
steps.tip: Use a high-nitrogen liquid feed from spring to late summer, then ease off in winter.

outro: Find its spot, then leave it alone. Consistency is everything.
